'''Whuddle''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At one point Whuddle possessed the mother of [[Vette]] and [[Tivva]] as a slave but she was worked to death. When the sisters discovered the matter, Tivva suggested taking revenge on the Hutt.

{{GameDSmechanics}}
The [[Empire's Wrath|Sith master of Vette]] encouraged it. Reluctantly, Vette slew the Hutt who killed her mother with Tivva, but quickly regretted it and resented the Sith for advising it.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior can advise Vette to not pursue vengeance against Whuddle for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light alignment points]].
